question: Who among the following did the Sports Authority of India appoint as the middle-and-long distance coach of the Indian athletics team in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nikolai Snesarev.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government has approved the appointment of **Belarussian coach Nikolai Snesarev** as the middle and long-distance coach of the Indian athletics team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Athletics Federation of India is the apex body** for running and managing athletics in India.
 
• The** headquarters** is located in New Delhi.
 
• The Athletics Federation of India nominated** star javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra for the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, the country's highest sporting honour.
 
• **Adille Sumariwalla** was elected as **Athletics Federation of India (AFI) president for a third term**.
 
• While former Indian athlete **Anju Bobby George **was elected as the senior **vice-president**.
 
• **Madhukant Pathak and Ravinder Chaudhary** were elected as treasurer and general secretary of AFI respectively.
